title: IBM OM raw-active p90 common-cell nine-level P&V
hypothesis: The nine array-wide physical-cell targets derived from the development p90 interval will retain at least 89 percent all-nine hidden support on held-out assignment 85001, and at least 90 percent of accepted exact-support held-out validation trajectories will have persistent endpoints nearest to the requested cell code.
motivation: The earlier raw-active QAT study used a variable quad-local baseline and therefore did not test one common physical baseline and increment. This study first characterizes nine common single-a_i cell states, without choosing a logical-weight mapper or running QAT. Because the canonical acceptance windows overlap, apparent acceptance alone is not evidence of state distinguishability.

arms.description: Frozen p90 codebook on repaired development assignment 84001 using 1,024 identities, four repeats, and nine targets.
The unchanged development codebook on untouched repaired assignment 85001 with matched identity sampling and pulse budgets.

completion_criteria: Both configs produce exactly one valid completed native run through python -m ebl characterize.

Development population fingerprint is 4887ad89abdd16193448c54a0cbe97be915cb4b9bc04cf1151c5e2a96ee5a3ac and held-out population fingerprint is 2721e735ba6722df27a879a5373de2d1da02481cb5eec05b592f967d27e74310.
The executable codebook uses B=0.6001664102077484, Delta_g=0.012380622327327728, k=0 through 8, and exactly 142,920 of 158,800 development cells support all nine targets.
Every arm executes 1,024 selected physical identities times four repeats times nine targets, for exactly 36,864 streamed trajectories, with per-trajectory conditioning and programming seeds.
Every trajectory starts from the same cloned lower-bound-conditioned state, uses the one-pulse controller, tau=0.00791586015294392, and a 128-pulse target budget.
The target mapper, plant, controller, and analysis never consume the AIHWKit reference state. No cell-wise rescaling, quad-local baseline, QAT, or on-chip update occurs.

Exact support, verify-window intersection, apparent acceptance, persistent-within-tolerance, nearest-code correctness, half-spacing correctness, ambiguity, pulse counts, reversals, saturation, and exhaustion remain distinct reported facts.
analysis_plan: Use held-out validation persistent nearest-code correctness among accepted exact-support trajectories as the primary nine-state diagnostic and compare it with the predeclared 90-percent threshold.
Check that held-out all-nine population support is at least 89 percent without adapting the codebook.

Report every target separately, including exact support, apparent acceptance, persistent tolerance, nearest-code correctness, ambiguity, pulse counts, RESET-after-overshoot reversals, saturation, and exhaustion.
Report the fraction of validation identity/repeats for which all nine targets are accepted and nearest-code correct; do not infer this joint result from marginal target rates.
Compare development and held-out assignments descriptively. Do not interpret this P&V-only study as QAT performance or evidence that on-chip training is required.
